bio: Whittle’s at Binswood is set in a Grade II-listed former Victorian school building situated in the heart Royal Leamington Spa. With luxurious décor, a unique relaxed atmosphere and a charming contemporary Afternoon Tea menu, Whittle’s at Binswood offers the ideal ambience for a memorable dining experience. Traditional Afternoon Tea comprises of a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, delectable fruit scones served with strawberry preserve and clotted cream, a variety of cream cakes, tea loaf and a pot of finest Twinning tea.  In addition to the exquisite food, the 19 th Century Victorian gothic hall is the ideal venue to unwind and sample expertly made cocktails, a glass of wine selected from the cellars of Berry brothers and Rudd or a casual coffee and cake with friends.  This venue is just a two minute walk from Leamington Spa's Regency shopping parade.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
